$comment: JNPA real-world grounding pack (spec §2). Publicly-sourced facts used ONLY to calibrate the simulation so the twin is recognisably JNPA, not a generic port. Every entry carries a `source`. These are public figures used to shape synthetic behaviour — NOT live JNPA data and NOT claimed baselines. Surfaced in the in-app Methodology & Assumptions panel.

port.name: Jawaharlal Nehru Port (JNPT), operated by JNPA

terminals.operatorNote: J M Baxi / CMA CGM consortium (oldest terminal)
DP World; commissioned 2000; 600 m quay, 2 berths
PSA International; 2,000 m quay; 4.8 M TEU capacity; India's largest container terminal; ~5.5 km from the older terminal cluster

cfsCount.unit: CFSs in the Nhava Sheva/Uran/Panvel belt (approx.)

cpp.name: Centralized Parking Plaza (CPP)
cpp.note: single-window customs documentation for DPE self-sealed export containers; modelled as a first-class node (buffer → documentation → gate release).

routing.$note: DPD/DPE/CFS/ICD routing splits are adjustable assumption sliders; defaults below. Labelled as assumptions.

import.source: ASSUMED (DPD savings ₹8,000–20,000 & days vs CFS routing, public)

itrho.note: Inter-Terminal Rail Handling Operation: mixed trains for multiple terminals are handled at one terminal's rail yard and road-transferred (ITT trailers) across the ~5.5 km BMCT gap. Heart of the Mixed Train Optimization KPI.
itrho.source: JNPA ITRHO public description (operational since Aug 2019)

rail.sidings: T1 and T2 rail sidings + terminal rail yards (BMCT has its own RMG rail yard, 4 RMGCs).
rail.dfc: JNPA is the terminus of the Western Dedicated Freight Corridor (WDFC).

customsArtifacts.source: GeM tender GEM/2026/B/7297343 Appendix C + corrigenda (mandatory artifacts)

recentEvent.name: May-2026 trailer-driver shortage congestion event
recentEvent.note: CFS-bound import pendency spiked; containers stranded >15 days went ~2,500 → 450 only after emergency measures (extra rail evacuation, CFS→DPD conversion, ITRHO charge waivers, green-channel CFS evacuation). Reconstructed as scenario class S5 inside the twin.
